none: PAS NLM-AF30D3: Rat Tailed Spoon from Middle Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Spoon, identified by the finder as a Roman rat-tailed spoon. A tapering cast round-section handle is flattened and expanded to a flat angular resting notch with an inscribed collar; light cross-hatching appears to indicate the finishing of this notched terminal with a file. This broader end is apparently soldered to the remnants of a rounded, possibly pear-shaped, bowl whose sides…
